subject: Request: PLG credit top-up and short grace window for Nimbus Labs evaluation
messages:
From: Luke Reynolds <luke@nimbuslabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuslabs.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick favor — evaluation credits expiring next week

Hi Ben / Hannah,

We're wrapping up our internal evaluation of Redwood's inference capabilities and appreciate how quickly your team has responded. Our sandbox account (nimbus-eval@nimbuslabs.ai) is down to about $120 of credits and the trial expires on 2026-12-04. We have an internal engineering spike that would require another ~$2k in credits to validate multi-region latency and KV-cache behavior across our pipelines.

Is there a way to get a short grace top-up (self-serve credit or promo code we can apply ourselves) — ideally something that can be redeemed immediately and remain valid for ~45 days so our procurement can finish paperwork? We're not asking for a long-term discount yet — just enough runway to finish the spike.

Thanks,
Luke
Luke Reynolds
Head of Developer Platform, Nimbus Labs
luke@nimbuslabs.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Luke Reynolds <luke@nimbuslabs.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, procurement@nimbuslabs.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick favor — evaluation credits expiring next week

Luke —

Thanks for the context and the clear ask. We can often approve short-term PLG credit top-ups as a self-serve promo code that you can redeem in the Console. To get this approved quickly I need to confirm two quick things so I can escalate to Ops/Billing: 1) target top-up amount (you mentioned ~ $2k — confirm), and 2) desired expiry date (45 days from issuance ok?).

If those two items look right I'll route for internal sign-off this morning and loop back with a promo code + short redemption instructions.

Also copying Hannah to request billing ops approval for a 60-day validity window if possible (we sometimes do 45–60 day windows for proofs of concept).

—Ben

ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Internal: Nimbus Labs — request for $2,000 PLG promo (short window)

Team,

Ben has a request from Nimbus Labs (Deal NBX-4791) for a $2,000 trial top-up to support an engineering spike. Current trial expiry: 2026-12-04. Request details below:
- Amount: $2,000 credit
- Redemption: self-serve promo code (customer redeems in Console)
- Desired validity: 45 days from issue; we typically can approve up to 60 days for POC accounts — please advise
- Use case: multi-region, KV/caching performance validation. Procurement is engaged but will not finish paperwork before the current credits expire.

I ran a quick check: usage profile is low risk, healthy signup activity, and MRR potential looks reasonable. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4791
Drive folder with evaluation logs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nimbus-eval-docs

Can billing ops (Marissa) confirm whether a 45-day self-serve promo code can be issued and whether we should extend to 60 days? If you approve, please return the promo code and a short authorization stub (PDF) I can share with the customer.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
